name: Spec-First Ship
description: One spec.md checkbox per iteration: plan, implement, verify, mark done.
kickoff:
Start the "Spec-First Ship" loop.
Goal: spec.md fully checked off
Max iterations: 15
Between iterations run: project tests
Exit when: no unchecked requirements in spec.md.
Orientation: read the linked ticket and locate spec.md before picking the next checkbox.
Step 1: Read spec.md and select the next unchecked requirement.

loop_contract.name: Spec-First Ship
loop_contract.goal: every requirement in spec.md is implemented and checked off
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Read spec.md (or project spec). Select the first unchecked requirement. Restate acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Pick unchecked spec item
steps.instruction: Read spec.md (or project spec). Select the first unchecked requirement. Restate acceptance criteria.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Pick unchecked spec item' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Plan the slice

steps.name: Mark spec and verify
